biotools.summary: The Genome Warehouse (GWH) is a public repository for genome-scale data, offering web services for submission, storage, release, and sharing. Recent enhancements focus on data value, security, and usability, including improved submission interfaces, enhanced search capabilities, and integration of new data types.
